title: fix(console): PWA manifest declares the branding icon's real type and size, with 192/512 PNG fallbacks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6KFUEBv4xhM1GGBkDXW4oV)_

Fixes #29332

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Console 运行时 PWA manifest 的图标不再一律写成 `image/svg+xml` + `sizes: 'any'`。品牌 favicon 是 SVG 时照旧;是 PNG/ICO 等位图时按真实类型与实测像素尺寸声明;没有 ≥192 px 正方形位图时,补上平台默认的 192/512 PNG(由现有 `favicon.svg` 渲染,新增两个静态文件)。
- **为什么改**:配了小尺寸 PNG favicon 的品牌 Console 在 Chrome 里不可安装(实测 `no-acceptable-icon`,最低 144 px),与 #29155 要的「品牌化可安装」相悖。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只动 Console 入口的 manifest 生成;manifest 链接改为在位图测量完成后才挂上(不阻塞首屏,最长 10 秒超时)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。取舍:小尺寸品牌 PNG 安装后,启动器图标显示的是平台默认图标而非品牌图标。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/pwaManifestIcons.ts`(`resolveManifestIcons` 的判定);`ui/apps/console/src/main.tsx`(`injectPwaManifest`,异步注入)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pwaManifestIcons.test.ts`,预期 23 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/pwaManifestIcons.ts` (new, console-local): `resolveManifestIcons(faviconUrl, baseURI)` builds the manifest icon entries.
  - SVG favicon, or no branding (the default `favicon.svg`): one entry, `image/svg+xml`, `sizes: 'any'`, as before. Nothing is loaded.
  - Raster favicon (PNG, ICO, WebP, JPEG, GIF, AVIF, by path extension or `data:` media type): the image is measured through `HTMLImageElement` and declared with its own type and `WIDTHxHEIGHT`. A favicon whose type is unknown, or that fails to load, measures zero or does not answer within 10 s, is left out rather than guessed.
  - Whenever the result has no square raster of at least 192 px, `icon-192.png` and `icon-512.png` are appended.
- `ui/apps/console/public/icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png` (new): the platform default icons, rendered once with Chromium from the existing `public/favicon.svg`. No default PNG icon existed anywhere in the repository and no server-rendered resize exists, so these are the card's "platform default icons" option (seat approved before the assets were added).
- `ui/apps/console/src/main.tsx`: the manifest block moves into `injectPwaManifest`, called without `await`. The static manifest is still removed synchronously, the native-host check is unchanged, and the Blob manifest link lands once the icon measurement settles, so first paint is never held for it. `start_url`, `scope` and the absolute icon URLs from #29326 are unchanged.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/console` patch.

Trade-off: a branding with a small raster favicon installs with the platform default icon at launcher sizes, since browsers pick the icon closest to the size they need. Upscaling a 32 px favicon client-side would look worse and needs canvas and CSP work, so the branded icon stays in the manifest at its true size and the defaults cover the large sizes.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pwaManifestIcons.test.ts`: 23/23 passed. Covers the manifest (through `generatePWAManifest`) for no branding, SVG, small PNG, large square PNG, large non-square PNG, ICO, an unmeasurable raster and an unknown type, plus `iconTypeOf` and the browser measurement (load, error, zero size, timeout).
- Ablation (back to the hard-coded `image/svg+xml` declaration, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `const type = iconTypeOf(src);`): 6 failed / 17 passed, the PNG, ICO, unmeasurable and unknown-type cases red; no branding and SVG stay green, as they should. Restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/console`: 71/71 tasks successful.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 33/33 exit 0 at `29065950`, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN), `vitest run scripts/` included (169 files passed). `origin/main` was merged afterwards (`1b6eb74f`); none of the merged commits touch these files, and the unit test re-ran green there (23/23).

## Acceptance notes

- The favicon link a few lines above the manifest block (and the same line in `index.html`) still labels every non-SVG favicon `image/png`, an ICO included. Out of this card's surface; browsers sniff favicon bytes, so nothing visible follows from it.

## Verification

Installability, read with CDP (`Page.getInstallabilityErrors`, `Page.getAppManifest`) in full Chromium (`launchPersistentContext`, `channel: 'chromium'`), on a `vite build` of the Console served under `/console/` with its `base` tag and a stubbed `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` carrying `branding.faviconUrl`.

| branding favicon | before (main's manifest block) | after (this branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 32 px PNG | `no-acceptable-icon` (minimum 144 px); icon declared `image/svg+xml`, `any` | no errors; icons `32x32` PNG + `192x192` + `512x512` |
| 256 px PNG | no errors; icon declared `image/svg+xml`, `any` | no errors; one icon `256x256` `image/png` |
| SVG | no errors; one SVG `any` | no errors; one SVG `any` |
| none | no errors; default SVG `any` | no errors; default SVG `any` |
